name: PCB Fab Laser SVG Export
description: Export SVG layers (copper negative, silkscreen, Edge.Cuts, drills, pads; front, back or both sides) for xTool laser PCB fabrication.
description_full: Generates per-side SVG files (front, back or both) sharing one board-outline bounding box: a 'copper' SVG (board outline minus copper), a separate 'silk' SVG of the silkscreen, a 'cut' SVG containing Edge.Cuts, a 'drill' SVG of via and pad drill targets, and a 'pads' SVG that strips the remaining paint off the pads for soldering. Back-side output is mirrored by default. 1:1 mm scale.
